title: Vietnam Mountain Marathon presented by Kailas Fuga — World Trail Majors
claims: World Trail Majors describes VMM as the oldest ultra trail race in Vietnam, established in 2013, now with up to 5,000 runners from 50 nations.
World Trail Majors says the flagship World Trail Majors distance is the VMM 100km with 5,500 m of gain, while the 70km, 50km (Short Series), 21km and 10km also run.
World Trail Majors says the race is held in Sapa, north of Hanoi, and is known for its mountaintop finish at a lodge.
The World Trail Majors 2026 race listing gives VMM dates of 2026/09/17-20.

verification.note: WTM 赛事页与 all-races 列表同日读取；WTM 把 50km 标注为 Short Series，官方 FAQ 则把 50km 与 100km 都称为 World Trail Majors race，两处并列。
